components.purpose: Starts an action or moves to the next step of a task with a short text label; optional leading icon and trailing icon, counter or shortcut; loading and disabled states; renders as a link with href.
components.whenNotToUse: Icon-only actions (IconButton), navigation inside text (Link), toggles with a pressed state (SegmentedControl, planned), lists of actions behind a trigger (Menu), rows of related buttons (ButtonGroup), toolbars (planned), width as a prop (layout decides).

components.purpose: Shows a vector glyph from the application's icon set (Phosphor conventions) at one of five system sizes in the current text color; decorative unless it carries a label, which makes it a named image; content of Button slots.
components.whenNotToUse: Actions without visible text (IconButton), multi-color artwork, logos and avatars (Avatar, planned), activity indicators (Spinner), statuses with text (Badge), icon fonts and sprite sheets.

components.purpose: Shows a quantity next to the thing it counts as a small rectangle in the inherited text color on a faint tint of it; overflow above a maximum (99+), tabular figures, three sizes named like Button; accessible phrase with label (8 unread messages); content of the Button trailing slot.
components.whenNotToUse: Statuses or categories in words (Badge), free text or amounts (plain text), a dot without a number, editing a quantity (NumberInput, planned), live announcements (integration), colored emphasis (not in this version).

components.purpose: Shows a keyboard combination written once in a platform-neutral notation (Mod+K) in the conventions of the user's platform (⌘K or Ctrl+K), plain beside a label or as keycaps on a neutral surface, with a spoken equivalent for assistive technology; content of the Button trailing slot.
components.whenNotToUse: Key sequences (compose two shortcuts), handling the keys (the application binds them), a shortcut quoted in a sentence (plain text), quantities (Counter), statuses (Badge), gestures, keycaps inside a Button or on a colored control.

components.purpose: Starts an action, or navigates to a task with href, from a compact square showing only an icon; the required label is the accessible name and is never shown; Button treatments and heights; loading and disabled states; 44 px target.
components.whenNotToUse: Room for a visible label (Button with a leading icon), links inside text (Link), toggles with a pressed state (SegmentedControl, planned), lists of actions behind a trigger (Menu), visible hints (Tooltip), dots or numbers over the icon (indicator, planned).

components.purpose: Navigates to another page or resource from inside text: underlined words in the font of the context, with a destination (page, external in a new tab, email, phone, file with visible format and size, printable version) shown by a glyph and announced; tone inherit for colored surfaces.
components.whenNotToUse: Navigation that reads like an action (Button with href), icon-only links (IconButton with href), actions such as printing or sending (Button), destinations that cannot be followed (plain text), structured navigation (Breadcrumb, Tabs, Pagination).

components.purpose: Labels an item with a short read-only status or category word (Paid, Draft, Overdue, Beta) in a small box colored by intent (neutral, accent, info, success, warning, danger) and appearance (subtle, strong), with an optional decorative leading icon; never interactive.
components.whenNotToUse: Quantities (Counter), values the user removes or selects (Tag, planned), dots without text or badges over another element (indicator, planned), explanations of a status (Alert), statuses inside a sentence (plain text), content of a Button slot (Counter).

components.purpose: Gives one form control (InputText, Textarea, Checkbox, RadioGroup or CheckboxGroup) its visible label, optional description, required asterisk and error message with an icon; names and describes the control and passes it the required, invalid and disabled state; never validates.
components.whenNotToUse: A toolbar search without a visible label (InputText with its label prop), a Switch (its own label), several fields under one heading (Fieldset, planned), a message about the whole form (Alert).

components.purpose: Lets the user type a short value on one line (text, email, password, search, phone, URL) at the height of a Button of the same size, with an optional decorative leading or trailing icon or one IconButton action (clear, show password) at md and lg.
components.whenNotToUse: Multi-line text (Textarea), a choice among known options (RadioGroup, Select, Combobox), numbers with steppers and dates (NumberInput, DatePicker planned), a value that cannot change (plain text).

components.purpose: Lets the user write text over several lines (comments, notes, messages); one row is as tall as an InputText of the same size; resize vertical, auto (grows up to maxRows) or none; Enter inserts a line break.
components.whenNotToUse: A short value on one line (InputText), formatted text (rich text editor, planned), a composer that sends on Enter (planned).

components.purpose: Lets the user turn one option on or off, or shows that some of a set is selected (indeterminate, for select all); label and optional description; the choice usually applies when a form is submitted.
components.whenNotToUse: A setting applied at once (Switch), exactly one choice (RadioGroup), several options under one question (CheckboxGroup), an immediate action (Button).

components.purpose: Gathers two or more related checkboxes that answer one question, any number of which can be checked; value lists the checked values in page order; required means at least one, stated in words by the Field; each checkbox is its own tab stop.
components.whenNotToUse: One independent option (Checkbox), exactly one choice (RadioGroup), settings applied at once (Switch), long or searchable lists (multi-select, planned), selection limits (validate in the application).

components.purpose: Turns a setting on or off with immediate effect (notifications, dark mode); the label names the setting, not its state; label at the end or at the start for aligned settings lists; no invalid or required state.
components.whenNotToUse: A choice confirmed later, validated or required (Checkbox), one choice among several (RadioGroup, SegmentedControl planned), an action (Button).

components.purpose: Asks for exactly one choice among a few options that all stay visible (Radio children with labels and descriptions), stacked or on a wrapping row; one tab stop with arrow keys; no return to no selection.
components.whenNotToUse: Many options or known names (Select, Combobox), several answers (CheckboxGroup), one on/off option (Checkbox or Switch), options as buttons or cards (SegmentedControl, planned).

components.purpose: One option of a RadioGroup: a circle, a label and an optional description; value unique within the group; size, readonly and invalid come from the group; only usable inside a RadioGroup.
components.whenNotToUse: On its own or outside a RadioGroup (Checkbox for one on/off option), options that can all be checked (Checkbox items in a CheckboxGroup).

components.purpose: Places related Buttons and IconButtons together (dialog footer, form actions, alert or card actions) with one size passed to every item, a density-aware gap and items centered on the cross axis; aligned start, center, end or stretched, or vertical at full width; a line that does not fit stacks at full width and is never reordered; a named group with label.
components.whenNotToUse: Controls acting on one object with one tab stop (Toolbar), attached buttons for a single choice (SegmentedControl, planned), overflow actions behind a trigger (Menu next to the group), a single action (Button), a split footer (two groups in a layout).

components.purpose: Shows that something is loading when its duration is unknown and its place is small, as a turning ring in the inherited content color at one of four icon-scale sizes (sm 16 to xl 32 px); decorative by default, a polite status named by its label when one is given; the loading indicator that Button and IconButton compose.
components.whenNotToUse: Busy buttons (the loading prop of Button and IconButton), known or long tasks (Progress, indeterminate when the end is unknown), first loads of a region with a known layout (Skeleton), colored or branded loading animations.

components.purpose: Shows how far a task of known size has gone, as a linear bar named by a required label shown above it (showLabel) with an optional percentage (showValue); value and max, an indeterminate state for a task without a known end, accent, success, warning or danger intents and three thicknesses.
components.whenNotToUse: Short waits in a small place (Spinner, or the loading prop of Button and IconButton), first loads of content (Skeleton), static values in a range (meter, planned), labelled steps (stepper, planned), circular progress.

components.purpose: Stands in for content that is loading with its shape and size, so that the layout does not move: text lines with the height of the body text of a size (lines, the last at 60 %), a block filling its container or a circle as wide as its box, pulsing in phase and hidden from assistive technology.
components.whenNotToUse: Short actions on content already shown (Spinner, or the loading prop of Button and IconButton), known or long tasks (Progress), regions with an unknown layout (Spinner), ready-made card or list skeletons (compose Skeletons), failed loads (Alert).

components.purpose: Shows a durable message in the flow of the page about the page, a section or a task, colored by intent (neutral, info, success, warning, danger) with its glyph; optional title, content with links, one ButtonGroup of small actions and a dismiss button that follow the intent (danger buttons keep their own); announced only with live, assertively for danger and warning.
components.whenNotToUse: Brief confirmations that leave by themselves (Toast), messages that must be answered (Dialog), an error on one field (Field), a status word on an item (Badge), page-wide banners fixed at the top (a composition in the layout).

components.purpose: Notifies briefly about something that just happened, in one notifications region above the page (placement, max with a queue): a title, an optional description, one small secondary action and a dismiss button, neutral or intense by intent; leaves after 5 s, 8 s with an action, never by default for danger; countdown paused on hover and focus; the application owns the list and removes a toast on dismiss.
components.whenNotToUse: Durable messages (Alert), messages that must be answered (Dialog), an error on one field (Field), feedback from an open modal dialog (inside the Dialog), rich content such as images or forms (Popover or Dialog), calls to action (the action is a secondary follow-up).

components.purpose: Shows a short plain text about one focusable Button, IconButton or Link (its name, a keyboard shortcut, a short clarification) on hover after a delay and at once on keyboard focus, in an inverse bubble of the top layer without an arrow; describes the trigger unless it repeats an IconButton's name; side top or bottom, align start, center or end, flips; Escape closes it without moving focus; one at a time; never opens on touch.
components.whenNotToUse: Interactive content or help opened by a press (Popover), information needed to complete a task (text on the page, Field description), explaining a disabled control (visible text next to it), messages after an action (Toast).

components.purpose: Opens a non-modal panel of free content (filters, a short form, details) anchored to one Button or IconButton rendered by a trigger snippet that spreads popovertarget and the popup attributes; the panel is a dialog named by label in the browser top layer, at most 360 px wide, side bottom or top, align start, center or end, flips; focus moves into the content, and Escape (back to the trigger), a press outside or focus leaving closes it; nests; bindable open.
components.whenNotToUse: Lists of actions (Menu), blocking tasks and confirmations (Dialog), text on hover or focus (Tooltip), one choice in a list (RadioGroup, Select, Combobox), long forms or wide content (Dialog, Drawer planned).

components.purpose: Asks the user to complete or abandon a short task or decision in a native modal window in the top layer: required title, optional description, close button, a body that scrolls between fixed header and footer, and a footer ButtonGroup with the primary action last; sizes sm, md, lg; alert dialog for decisions; can require an explicit choice; the page behind is dimmed and inert, focus is kept inside and returned on close.
components.whenNotToUse: Non-blocking content next to a trigger (Popover), messages that need no answer (Alert, Toast), lists of actions behind a button (Menu), side panels (Drawer, planned), full-screen windows and multi-step wizards (compositions, planned).

components.purpose: Offers a short list of actions or links in a top-layer panel opened from one Button or IconButton trigger, with the menu button keyboard pattern (arrows, Home, End, typeahead, Escape and Tab close); items with a leading icon, a trailing Shortcut, danger intent, disabled state or href, separators and labelled groups; reports the value of the activated item and closes.
components.whenNotToUse: Choosing a value in a form (RadioGroup, Select), free content or forms in an anchored panel (Popover), actions that fit on screen (ButtonGroup), checkable items and submenus (not built in), right-click menus (ContextMenu, planned), bars of controls (Toolbar).

components.purpose: Groups controls that act on the same context (Button, IconButton, Menu, Popover triggers) as one tab stop with arrow-key navigation (roving focus), separated by ToolbarSeparator; imposes its size on the controls; a horizontal toolbar fills its width and moves the controls that do not fit, from the end, into an overflow Menu that keeps their label, icon, disabled state and danger intent; required label.
components.whenNotToUse: A row of unrelated or few buttons (ButtonGroup or a layout), a list of actions in a panel (Menu), toggle buttons and formatting states (not in v1; SegmentedControl, planned), navigation between pages or panels (Tabs, links).

components.purpose: Chooses one value from about five to twenty-five known options shown collapsed in an InputText-like field: options as records (value, label, disabled, group), placeholder, size, readonly, disabled, invalid, required, leading icon; the select-only combobox keyboard pattern with typeahead; a top-layer list panel that scrolls past a fixed height; bindable value and open, valueChange and openChange events.
components.whenNotToUse: Fewer than five options (RadioGroup), a long list or one the user searches (Combobox), free text with suggestions (InputText), a list of actions (Menu), several values (CheckboxGroup).

components.purpose: Chooses one value from a long list by typing to narrow it (a country, a person, a project): an InputText-like field with a list panel that filters options by label (contains, ignoring case and accents) or shows options the application supplies (filter none), an empty label, groups, disabled options; the value is always an option (free text is not a value); bindable value, inputValue and open with valueChange, inputChange and openChange events.
components.whenNotToUse: A short list without search (Select), free text with suggestions (InputText), few options visible at once (RadioGroup), several values (planned).

components.purpose: Stacks headings that each show or hide a section of content (questions and answers, settings sections, details): items with a label, an optional leading icon and free content, inside headings of a chosen level; one or several expanded at a time (multiple), disabled items; arrow keys between triggers; bindable value list with valueChange.
components.whenNotToUse: Navigation between pages (links, Breadcrumb), panels switched in place with a visible list (Tabs), content every user needs (show it), a single show-or-hide toggle (Disclosure, planned).

components.purpose: Shows where the current page sits in the site hierarchy as a navigation landmark: items as records (label, href, hideLabel) from a top level to the current page, a leading snippet (a home icon), chevron or slash separators, size sm or md; labels truncate ancestors first on one line; maxItems collapses hidden items behind a “…” button that opens a Menu of them.
components.whenNotToUse: A history of visited pages (not a breadcrumb), the steps of a task (Stepper, planned), the main navigation (a navigation bar), a single back link (Link).

components.purpose: Moves through a long list or table split into numbered pages: page items (current page marked), ellipses for hidden runs, Previous and Next IconButtons, optional First and Last (showEdges); a constant number of items so the controls do not move; one row that reduces siblings when narrow; buttons or links (href with {page}); bindable page with pageChange.
components.whenNotToUse: A feed read in order (a Load more Button or infinite scrolling), steps of a task (Stepper, planned), panels of related content (Tabs).

components.purpose: Shows one of several panels of related content in the same place with a list of tabs: appearance contained (default, the list as a container, the selected tab raised) or line (the selected tab marked by an indicator and its label in the indicator color), horizontal or vertical, sizes, leading icon and trailing Counter or Badge per tab, disabled tabs, automatic or manual activation; the list scrolls with faded edges and scroll buttons when the tabs do not fit; bindable value with valueChange.
components.whenNotToUse: Navigation between pages (links styled as navigation), several sections shown at once (Accordion), a choice of value (RadioGroup, SegmentedControl planned), steps of a task (Stepper, planned).

foundations.title: Foundations
foundations.purpose: Token layers (role, palette, primitive), CSS custom property names, the brand, appearance and density context, and the rules for using tokens in application styles.

foundations.title: Color
foundations.purpose: Which color role to use for surfaces, content, borders and focus, selection, actions, fields and statuses, and on which surfaces each content role is guaranteed 4.5:1 or 3:1.

foundations.title: Typography
foundations.purpose: Which typography role to use for display, headings, body, labels, captions, overlines, numerals, indicators and code, and how to apply a role in CSS.

foundations.title: Spacing and sizing
foundations.purpose: Layout, content and control spacing, control heights, icon and avatar sizes and the 44 px interaction target; what follows the density.

foundations.title: Shape
foundations.purpose: Radius roles by what they round (control, focus, container, overlay, indicator, full), border widths and the focus outline.

foundations.title: Elevation and layers
foundations.purpose: Shadows paired with surfaces, z-index layers and opacity roles.

foundations.title: Motion
foundations.purpose: Duration and easing roles and reduced motion.

foundations.title: Contracts and evidence
foundations.purpose: What a component contract contains (props, parts, states, events, token roles, rules), how to use it to build another implementation, and how components are verified and approved.
